#!/bin/bash
# Start OpenClaw Command Center
# Usage: ./start.sh [--tunnel]

SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")" && pwd)"
PORT=3333
TUNNEL=false
PID_FILE="/tmp/openclaw-dashboard.pid"
TUNNEL_PID_FILE="/tmp/openclaw-tunnel.pid"

# Parse args
while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
    case $1 in
        --tunnel|-t)
            TUNNEL=true
            shift
            ;;
        --port|-p)
            PORT="$2"
            shift 2
            ;;
        *)
            shift
            ;;
    esac
done

# Check
